info.title: Syncero Flow — Integration API
info.description:
External integration API for **Syncero Flow**.

> 🚧 **Coming soon** — no external routes are available at this time.
> This spec is reserved for future integrations of the financial management app.

### What will be here
Endpoints that will allow external systems (ERPs, payment gateways, banks) to send data directly to companies in Flow — such as bank statement imports, automatic reconciliation and payment webhooks.

### Authentication (future)
Flow's external routes will use `x-api-key` generated in the company settings panel.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Company API Key (generation coming soon in the Flow settings panel).
